notes:
- Updates: NabuCode checks for new versions on start and installs them in one click; choose the Stable, Beta or Nightly channel in Settings → General
- Browser for the agent: it opens sites, reads pages, clicks and types, with a Browser panel to watch it live and take over
- Chrome extension: the agent can also work in your own Chrome, and a side panel in Chrome chats with NabuCode; setup in Settings → Browser
- Browser settings: default search engine, clear cache and site data
- Skills settings page: where skills come from, search, turn skills on and off one by one
- Chats without a project and temporary chats
- Drafts in the message field are kept per chat, with attachments, and survive restarts
- Compaction settings: pick the compaction model and its effort
- Themes: accent color, colored themes highlight commands in their own color
- `/` and `@` list: arrow keys and Ctrl+W/S move the choice, the mouse wheel follows the cursor
- File tree keeps its scroll position; Collapse all folders works; Show in Explorer selects the file
- Cleaner window edges, a narrow window keeps the chat readable, long chat titles no longer run under the buttons
- Terminal follows the project when you switch projects; Settings show the real app version
- Effort popup stays inside a narrow window; the expanded diff closes on New chat and keeps the window outline
- Claude Account and ChatGPT Account requests match the official Claude Code and Codex clients more closely
- CoArena keys stay usable on per-minute rate limits; DeepAI follows the server's assigned lane
